# @loom/scaffold

Shared code templates + registration codegen for Loom — used by create-loom-app (whole app) and `loom new`/`loom gen` (single files + generated registration)

## Entry points

- `@loom/scaffold`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
